posts.title: Windows event logs were cleared, but resurrected in another file!
posts.description: TL;DR: The Windows Event Logging Service contains a bug (use of uninitialized memory) that sometimes results in recently deleted (cleared) log entries being stored in other (unrelated) *.evtx journal files.
